title: Nigeria records first Ebola case as outbreak spreads

blocks.text: LAGOS, Nigeria — Nigeria said Tuesday it had recorded its first Ebola case of Africa’s latest outbreak, as Kenya declared its ninth case, prompting a regional health official to warn of “an extremely serious threat”.
